title: THE GREAT DEBATE
about: The Governor stages a debate on whether ranchers exist or only copy the Form of the Cowboy; his podcast philosopher questions everything, a rancher answers with a cow, and the state declares the wrong man the winner.

beats.text: A Texas ranch yard dressed up with foam columns as an ancient Greek marketplace. Ranchers sit on hay bales for the Governor's first great public debate.
Tonight's question is simple: Do you exist... or are you just participating in the Form of the Cowboy?
The Governor's expert sits on stage in a tub of ice water, wearing a headset, ready to explain Plato to the ranchers.
see: a man sitting in a bathtub

beats.text: Okay, so listen. Plato's like, there's the real world, and there's the shadow world.
I'm gonna stop you right there, man. I seen shadows. They exist.
No, no, the idea is... like... you think you're a cowboy, right? But what if "cowboy" is just a pattern.
Cowboy is a job.
Right, but like... what is a job, truly?
The expert takes the cowboy apart. The hat is not the cowboy. The boots are not the cowboy. The truck is not the cowboy.
see: a cowboy hat on a fence post

beats.text: But the point is, if you remove all the stuff... what's left?
Me.
But how do you know it's you?
Because I'm right here.
Okay. Here's the real question: If the state says "Cowboy" is just a role, and roles are illusions, then you don't need private property.
The crowd hears one thing: someone wants their land. The Governor insists nobody is stealing. They are only reclassifying.
The expert tries one last example. A cow is chewing by the fence.
Okay. That cow. Is it a cow, or is it participating in the Form of Cow?
That cow exists.
How do you know?
Because if I touch it wrong, it'll kick me. Reality is what can hurt you.
Pain isn't real, though, if you...
Then get back in the tub and stay there.

beats.ask: now that makes sense to me

beats.text: The crowd cheers for the rancher. The Governor grabs the microphone to name the winner.
I declare Joe the winner!
Wait, what? No, I don't think... I think Earl just won.
Joe is Gold Class. Gold Class wins. That's the Noble Lie.
The cow moos, long and unimpressed. The Governor's young Plato translator looks straight into the camera.
see: a young man looking at the camera

beats.text: If they try to turn the cow into a citizen, I'm quitting.
